t: What Fatigue Life Evidence Database Is All About
title: What Fatigue Life Evidence Database Is All About
description: Fatigue kills below yield: cyclic stress grows cracks from invisible to catastrophic — the Comet's windows, Liberty ships' hulls. S-N curves (Wöhler) map stress to cycles; Miner's rule sums damage fractions; fracture mechanics (Paris law) grows measured cracks. Endurance limit: steels survive infinite cycles below ~half tensile; aluminum has none. Test, don't guess. This database is the complete fatigue record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
